text.p: These are the main stories in Latvian newspapers on Wednesday. Prepared for Reuters by the Co-operation Fund. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- President Ulmanis visited Latvia's second city of Daugavpils to discuss issues of concern to the city's mostly Russian speaking population.

- Estonian and Latvian police have arrested a man they suspect is "Victor", the internet extortionist who threatened to blow up hotels and shops in Riga. He was apprehended while crossing the Latvian-Estonian border.
- Two of the boys injured in the Talsi tragedy have received medical treatment in Sweden and have returned to Latvia.
DIENA - Before leaving office, Interior Minister Dainis Turlais has issued an order lifting penalties from those officials who have been penalised in connection with the tragedy at Talsi.
NEATKARIGA RITA AVIZE - Valmiera meat packing plant is reported to have received suspicious meat from Holland.
DIENAS BIZNESS - The Latvian shipping company is putting in operation its second liquid gas carrier today. The first was launched in April.
